maya (docs): quick ping 3 pr opened to consolidate Optimize toolkit notes: batching/caching/quant profiles + two SDK snippets. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/500

omar (optimize): thanks. please add an explicit "when not to batch" callout (long seq or memory-bound workloads).

lee (sdk): updated Python and JS streaming examples to the new APIs. also noted min SDKs: JS >=0.9.5, Py >=1.2.2.

ci-bot: link-check: /eng-runtime/batching-scheduler.md resolved. lint: code-block widths flagged in JS snippet.

maya (docs): fixed wrapping and added a 2-line migration checklist for hosted->dedicated: pin model & quant_profile, run 50-seed QA, enable canary. pushed.

omar (optimize): neat. add one sentence about cost tradeoffs for aggressive quant (memory savings vs possible small regressions).

maya (docs): added it and a suggested AB test prompt set. ci-bot: all checks passing. merging once green.

lee (sdk): thumbs up. will follow up if customers report tokenization diffs.
